open_points.subject: ProjectValidationResult field consistency and access-management mutations
open_points.text: Access-management operations "proceed only when both [exists and is_active] are true" and A6 says each caller acts on its named field "whatever the others say"; but A5 also says "a status outside the two is never treated as active," its table rejects archived mutations, State 1 M17 says only active and archived statuses are acted on, and A4's PLAT-REG-003 requires typed validation to report the project as active.
open_points.question: When a decoded validation answer has exists=true and is_active=true but status is archived or an unsupported value, may a viewer grant, staff assignment, or producer grant be created, or must the contradictory answer be refused; conversely, does is_active=false override status=active?
options: Use exists and is_active for access-management creation even when status contradicts them
Use status as the authoritative lifecycle field for every linked mutation
Reject inconsistent fields as schema_mismatch or another specified boundary failure
open_points.default_guess: Reject any inconsistent validation answer as schema_mismatch before permitting a linked mutation.

witness.initial: An administrator has an active session and portal.access.manage; the target viewer exists and has no grant for project P.
events: The administrator requests a new viewer grant for P.
Registry validation returns project_id=P, exists=true, is_active=true, status="archived", failure=null.
outcomes: The grant is created because the viewer-grant caller checks only exists and is_active.
The grant is refused because archived mutations are rejected and an archived status is never treated as active.
witness.observer: The administrator sees success versus refusal, and the viewer later either can or cannot read project P.
